description: Election Commission - Filling of Vacancy of the Members of the Kurunegala Municipal Council, Trincomalee Urban Council and Meerigama Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in local government councils (Kurunegala Municipal Council, Trincomalee Urban Council, Meerigama Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically addresses electoral processes including vacancy declarations, political party nominations, and the formal selection of new council members to fill seats vacated due to death, resignation, or party membership cessation. This falls directly under election-related matters as defined in Type 7.
